description: Values mub6_collar_boundary.rs reads instead of computing them. None is evidence for any MUB(6) statement.

karlsson_volume_margin.reason: Margin of the Karlsson exterior, set equal to the base gap; no Karlsson cover is run here. Sets the interface margin, the overlap-layer effective margin and the 2 -> 0 transition defect of the collar boundary receipt.

collar_layer_certified.reason: collar_certified on every interface box is written as true; only the collar margin at the depth is checked to be positive. Feeds the collar boundary partition and receipt (mub_target_a8_collar_boundary_receipt.json analogue).

overlap_layer_karlsson_certified.reason: karlsson_certified on the overlap-layer boxes is written as true without a Karlsson cover check. Feeds the collar boundary partition and receipt (mub_target_a8_collar_boundary_receipt.json analogue).
